name: Illinois

tipped.note: employers may pay 60% of the minimum wage to tipped employees

minWage.other: Youth under 18 working fewer than 650 hours per calendar year: $13.00

source.quote: Guarantees a minimum wage of $15.00 per hour for workers 18 years of age and older. An employer where gratuities are paid to employee, may pay 60% of the minimum wage

localMinWages.name: Chicago
localMinWages.note: employers with 4 or more employees; tipped workers $12.96; adjusted every July 1 by CPI or 2.5%, whichever is lower

source.quote: As of July 1, 2026, the minimum wage in Chicago is $17.05 per hour for employers with 4 or more employees.

localMinWages.name: Cook County
localMinWages.note: tipped employees $9.25; applies where municipalities have not opted out

source.quote: As of July 1, 2026, the minimum wage in Cook County is $15.40 per hour for non-tipped employees and $9.25 per hour for tipped employees.

overtime.exemptSalaryNote: Illinois follows the federal white-collar salary threshold

source.quote: Overtime must be paid after 40 hour of work per week at time and one-half the regular rate.

sickLeave.accrual: 1 hour of paid leave for every 40 hours worked, usable for any reason (Paid Leave for All Workers Act)
sickLeave.capNote: up to 40 hours per 12-month period (or frontloaded); usable after 90 days of employment. Chicago and Cook County have their own ordinances instead (Chicago: 1 h paid leave + 1 h paid sick leave per 35 h worked)
sickLeave.note: Leave can be taken for any reason; no reason may be required. Not paid out at separation unless it is part of a vacation/PTO bank.

source.quote: PLAWA went into effect on January 1, 2024. Accrual of paid leave begins upon the start of employment or January 1, 2024, whichever is later.

finalPay.fired: by the next regularly scheduled payday
finalPay.quit: by the next regularly scheduled payday
finalPay.ptoNote: earned vacation under a contract, agreement or policy must be paid at separation (Section 300.520); PLAWA paid leave is not, unless it is part of a vacation/PTO bank

source.quote: All final compensation, including bonus payments, vacation pay, wages and commissions must be paid on your next regularly scheduled payday.

ptoSource.quote: Yes. A former employee has a claim under the Act for the collection of the monetary equivalent of his/her vacation time earned in accordance with an employment contract, agreement or policy.

breaks.meal: 20-minute meal break for every 7.5 hours worked, no later than 5 hours after the start of the shift; an additional 20 minutes for shifts of 12 hours or longer

source.quote: employees must be permitted to take a meal break for every 7.5 hours worked no later than 5 hours after the start of the shift. An additional 20-minute meal break must be permitted if working a 12-hour shift or longer.

notes.text: The Paid Leave for All Workers Act (in force since January 1, 2024) gives up to 40 hours of paid leave a year that can be used for any reason, not only illness; employers cannot require a reason.

source.quote: can use paid leave for any reason and employers may not require workers to provide a basis for their time off request. Workers earn one (1) hour of paid leave for every 40 hours they work.

notes.text: Workers in Chicago and Cook County are covered by local paid leave ordinances instead of the state act; Chicago grants 1 hour of paid leave plus 1 hour of paid sick leave per 35 hours worked.

source.quote: For every 35 hours worked, employees accrue one hour of paid leave and one hour of paid sick leave.

notes.text: Illinois will stop recognizing licenses to pay workers with disabilities less than the minimum wage on December 31, 2029.

source.quote: On December 31, 2029, the Illinois Department of Labor will stop issuing and recognizing licenses to pay disabled workers less than the full minimum wage rate
